sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant to direct the learned trial court not to insist the applicant to file separate surety bonds in two cases and accept only one surety in lieu of two cases.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the cases shown in paragraph 5 of the application.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the Faisal Ahmad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt., ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169349764/
1 applicant has been released on bail in following cases:-
(i) Crime No. 0125/2023, under Section 452, 354, 506 Indian Penal Code and Section 7/8 POCSO Act, Police Station Jankipuram, District Lucknow.
(ii) Crime No.0179 of 2023, under Section 363, 366, 376, 342, 506 Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 POCSO Act Police station Jankipuram, District Lucknow.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to poor financial condition, the applicant is not in a position to manage sureties in two cases.

sentences.text: Opposing the prayer of the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State submits that it is always the discretion and satisfaction of the concerned trial court so far as the acceptance of the surety is concerned.

Considering the aforesaid, it is provided that the applicant may furnish a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties which shall be treated to be valid in both the cases above mentioned in which the bail orders have been passed.
With these observations, the petition is disposed of.
